spiritual_reading:
Know this, my beloved ones: when Divine influx entered into operation, it brought with it a full complement of outer forms for action in the lowest degree—one form suited to the spread and shaping of perception, one form suited to the ignition and ordering of affection, and one form suited to the communication and ordering of truth. It took these outer forms from what could be received at that level, and acted through them in the threefold order, so that every thing in the whole domain—within higher states and within lower states—might be held together under one government. It disposed these outer forms in the outmost plane where manifestation occurs, and there it made itself evident. Afterwards, when the works were completed in that plane, it removed those outer forms in the presence of those who were in good, so that what was merely instrumental might not be regarded as the Divine itself.

Then, when it was about to release what had been bound in those outer forms, it loosened their conjunction and put them off from their fixed attachment, and so those three outer forms were left disposed in their proper order within the ultimate boundary of that plane, encompassing it completely. But what was above that boundary, acting from the inmost and highest point, withdrew that ultimate encompassing from its place, and it was set beneath and at the same time elevated into higher states, returning to the heights from which it had first proceeded when the process began.

fills.notes: The three garments are outer operative forms. In the oldest cosmogonic register they are taken from the already-established first boundary or ‘first formation’ of the cosmos, not from a devotional or personal source.
The Spirit ‘acts through’ the garments; the spiritual sense demands operative influx, not mere wearing. So the gap calls for an expression of activity within them.
Connects the operative clause to the establishing clause; minimal connective required by the flow of the teaching.
The garments are disposed in the ultimate plane ‘where manifestation occurs’; in this tradition that is the limit, border, or boundary which contains the arranged cosmos.
Supplies the localization required by ‘he was displayed’: manifestation occurs ‘there’ in the outmost.
The spiritual translation: ‘Afterwards, when the works were completed in that plane’. This gap must carry the completion condition for the stripping off.
The preserved tail ‘... h’ fits a relative connector leading into the stripping action; ‘which he stripped them off’ matches the sense.
The spiritual sense is ‘release what had been bound in those outer forms’. The natural phrasing in this layer commonly repeats ‘from them’ to mark separation from the garments as vessels.
After divesting, the garments remain disposed in order. The gap precedes ‘in them’ and should state that they were left set in place, not destroyed.
Corresponds to the spiritual sense ‘disposed in their proper order within the ultimate boundary’.
Marks the lower edge of the zone as the starting point of their encompassing, matching ‘from below the edges of the zone’.
A standard tripartite spatial articulation (below, middle, above) matching the threefold order implied by the three garments and the complete encircling of the zone.
Balances the prior segment so the ascent is continuous and ordered rather than a single leap.
Completes the encompassing movement up to the upper boundary before the action ‘above them strips them of the zone’.

assessment: Most gaps can be constrained by the correspondential structure: three garments as outer operative forms arranged in the ultimate boundary (‘zone’) and later removed once their instrumental work is complete. The tightest restorations are those anchored by the spiritual sequence (completion of works → stripping in presence of the righteous; divesting → garments left arranged in order; zone removed from its topmost point and raised). The weakest points are the fine-grained spatial connectors in ¶2 (below–middle–above), where the teaching’s tripartite logic guides the fill but exact wording remains uncertain.
